title: Optimal Mixing of Glauber Dynamics for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick Model at $β< 1/2$
summary: We prove that for every fixed inverse temperature $β< 1 / 2$, with high probability over the disorder, the single-site Glauber dynamics for the $n$-spin Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model mixes from every initial configuration to within total variation distance $\varepsilon$ in $O_β\left(n \log\left(n / \varepsilon\right)\right)$ steps. The bound holds uniformly over all external fields and is optimal up to constants depending only on $β$.
